items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: He was a pupil of Stuart Davis, who became -- you know, Rockefeller paid $80,000 for a Stuart Davis, which is just as you walk up into the Museum of Modern Art in New York, I think the painting is still there.

ctx.x: Yes, I remember that. And he painted, too.

And he was a marvelous painter. He was a pupil of Stuart Davis, who became -- you know, Rockefeller paid $80,000 for a Stuart Davis, which is just as you walk up into the Museum of Modern Art in New York, I think the painting is still there. It's not exactly a painting. It looks like a rug.
